podcast.body: The American version of this album included The Attractions' take on Nick Lowe's "What's So Funny About Peace, Love and Understanding," which, though never issued as an A-side, was played extensively on album rock radio. This exposure, along with the single "Accidents Will Happen," fueled *Armed Forces* to become Costello's biggest US album, reaching number 10 on the Billboard album chart by March 1979. However, radio stations later pulled the LP from rotation after details of his drunken incident in Columbus, Ohio, were leaked. "Armed Forces."

podcast.body: This was Costello's third album, released as part of a highly prolific period where he released a new album every year between 1977 and 1986. His rapid output, while critically acclaimed, often outpaced his record label's marketing efforts and the music press's ability to digest the material. "Armed Forces from 1979."
